summary.limitations: This is reported technology use among enterprises in the survey scope, not a measure of intensity, total investment or productivity. The headline combines AI technologies beyond generation. Neither the EU adoption share nor the language-generation share measures quarterly euro area real GDP or identifies an effect on it.
summary.observed: Eurostat reported that 13.5% of EU enterprises with at least ten employees used AI in 2024, compared with 8.0% in 2023. It distinguished written-language analysis from generation: 6.9% used text mining and 5.4% used tools to generate written or spoken language. The latter category grew by 3.3 percentage points compared with 2023.

summary.limitations: These rates compare price levels with the same month a year earlier; they are not April monthly changes. The component decomposition describes contributions within the index. It does not establish which share of the movement was caused by the pandemic or by policy.
summary.observed: The euro area annual inflation rate fell from 0.7% in March to 0.3% in April 2020. Eurostat described April as a month of containment measures across countries. Energy contributed -0.97 percentage points to euro area inflation, while food, alcohol and tobacco contributed +0.67 points and services +0.52 points. The EU aggregate was 0.7%, compared with 1.2% in March.

summary.institutional_interpretation: The Council described the larger envelope as a response to a weaker projected inflation path and as support for financing conditions for households and businesses.
summary.limitations: The release is a policy decision and rationale, not the statistical source for observed HICP. Purchase envelopes and intended dates should not be read as completed transactions or guaranteed effects on financing conditions.
summary.observed: The ECB kept its deposit facility rate at -0.50% on 4 June 2020. The Governing Council raised the PEPP envelope by EUR 600 billion to EUR 1.35 trillion and extended the intended horizon for net purchases to at least the end of June 2021, subject to its assessment of the crisis. It also announced a reinvestment horizon for maturing principal payments.

summary.observed: Eurostat's 14 February 2024 flash release reported that seasonally adjusted real GDP was unchanged in the euro area in 2023 Q4 relative to Q3. The EU aggregate increased by 0.1%.
